subject: The cutting stylus caught mid-cut in a textbook cross-section of the lacquer blank, its V sunk into the coat and a swarf thread coiling off behind it.
controls: cut: shape (node 0, the groove under the stylus) - the V deepens from ~7 to ~22 px and its point bottoms out into a flat floor as the cutter saturates (1.4 to ~9 px flat); the stylus (node 1) rides down with it.

groove: position - the blank slides under the fixed stylus: the rim bevel runs out to the left and the uncut inner lacquer's break line comes in from the right (~160-170 px), so more cut grooves trail the stylus.
wear: count - chips and rounded lips appear on the grooves already cut, left of the stylus (0 to ~14 marks); none at 0.
rumble: shape - the platter line under the blank rises into a slow wave (0 to +-10 px); flat at 0.
reference: opxy/reference/README.md (MNMD MD KIT section drawings, linked) and library/theseus-tower for line weight
risks: Header-wide section (x 160-460) leaves a lot of thin horizontal lines; the lacquer hatching is close to the 3 px floor (5 px spacing, hairline) and could smear on the panel. Rumble's platter line is 420 px long, so as a mutable outline it needs four 64-point runs or it has to be re-thought as a few translated segments. wear's chips are small (3-4 px) and only appear on the 3-4 cut grooves at groove 0. Effects get no note input, so nothing answers playing: the drawing only moves when a knob turns.
